about: The console film's script: stretto-console, driven over its test fixtures (capture.sh), page by page. Chapters (`beats`) of lines, as the explainer's: `text` is the caption, `say` what the voice says, `em` the phrases lit in petrol, `post` the pause after a line. Every line describes what its shot shows, and the console's own docs (docs/console.md) say. narrate.py voices it (console-video).

lines.text: The console is stretto's management plane: a web app on your own machine.
It reads the files stretto writes, through stretto's own code.
The overview counts this week's sessions, and the agent's calls and the lookups flows served.
Below, each domain: a server's name, with its sessions, flows and registry entry.
Servers lists the MCP servers stretto fronts: recording, in shadow, or serving a flow.
Each shows what stretto init prints, to paste into your host. The console never edits your host.
Test the connection, and it lists the server's tools, each marked read or write.
Sessions lists every recording: served, in shadow, or recorded.
Open a served one. After the agent's first call, the flow read ahead three times.
Each lookup shows its chance, times its binding, against the threshold.
Decisions lists them all, with where the flow handed back, and why.
In shadow, it shows what the flow would have read, with nothing looked up.
A flow's page draws its graph: the calls it decides after, and the reads it makes.
Move the threshold to 0.5, and one of its three sites hands back.
lines.say: Move the threshold to zero point five, and one of its three sites hands back.

lines.text: Review renders the flow for a reviewer. Compare shows what changed against another.
Jobs run the stretto CLI from the page: learn, promote, audit, and more.
Here, an audit of the shop flow on its served sessions. The report opens in place.
Control K jumps to any page, server, session or flow.
Start it read-only, and it refuses every change.
Run it with make console in a checkout, or in a container with docker compose.
